item.title: Job 28: Where True Wisdom Is Found
item.description: In Job 28, Scripture asks where true wisdom can be found. This episode explains that wisdom belongs to God alone and begins with the fear of the Lord.

item.title: Standing Firm in Faith When the World Opposes Us
item.description: How can Christians remain steadfast when the world opposes them? Dave Jenkins answers this question from Hebrews 10:23, offering biblical encouragement to stand firm in Christ.

item.title: Remembering Past Blessings While Trusting God Today (Job 29)
item.description: In Job 29, Job reflects on a season of blessing, honor, and intimate fellowship with God—a time that now feels painfully distant in the midst of his suffering. This episode walks through Job 29 and calls listeners to honest lament and deeper trust in God’s unchanging faithfulness, secured in Jesus Christ.

item.title: Job 30: Faith in the Darkness of Suffering
item.description: In Job 30, Job moves from honor to humiliation and gives voice to deep suffering. This episode shows how biblical lament is not unbelief, but faith honestly brought before God, pointing us to Jesus Christ, the Man of Sorrows.
